caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped object with a hole at both the top and bottom, resembling a tag or badge. It is rendered in grayscale pencil or charcoal. At the center of the tag is a depiction of a fire hydrant, around which a snake is coiled. The hydrant is shown with angular facets, and the snake’s body wraps around it, with the head of the snake near the middle left side. Behind and below the hydrant and snake, there appears to be a stylized leafy or flame-like base. At the upper part of the drawing, on either side of the hydrant, are the large, capital letters “F” on the left and “A” on the right. Near the bottom of the tag the number "20682" is inscribed. The shading is used to define the roundness and the three-dimensionality of the objects, and the overall background is a light beige.
title: Firemark
